title: Review and iterate PRD.md and PLAN.md for workspace-fs
description:
Create and iterate the PRD.md and PLAN.md documents for the workspace-fs crate, following the same process used for workspace-core.

**Context:**
- workspace-fs is an internal dependency required by workspace-core (see PRD §1.4.1)
- It should provide filesystem abstraction for all workspace-node-tools crates
- This crate enables testing via mocking and potential future async support

**Task Workflow:**
1. Review existing filesystem patterns in the legacy crate (temp/wnt-stable)
2. Create initial PRD.md defining the scope and requirements for workspace-fs
3. Collaborative iteration with developer to refine requirements
4. Create PLAN.md with implementation tasks (following workspace-core format)
5. Ensure all tasks have standard acceptance criteria (Clippy, Fmt, Docs, Tests, Build, Review)
6. Final validation before implementation begins

**Expected Outcomes:**
- PRD.md for workspace-fs with clear scope and requirements
- PLAN.md with detailed implementation tasks and PRD references
- Ready-to-implement specification

**Reference Files:**
- crates/core/PRD.md (for format reference)
- crates/core/PLAN.md (for format reference)
- temp/wnt-stable/crates/standard (legacy patterns)
close_reason: Created PRD.md and PLAN.md for workspace-fs crate with async-first architecture using tokio::fs, configurable timeouts, and workspace inheritance for shared dependencies

title: Review and iterate PRD.md and PLAN.md for workspace-core
description:
The initial PRD.md and PLAN.md documents were created based on analysis of the legacy crate (temp/wnt-stable/crates/standard), but they have not yet been reviewed and iterated with the developer.

This task requires collaborative refinement between the AI model and the developer to ensure the specifications accurately reflect the desired implementation approach.

**Current State:**
- PRD.md and PLAN.md exist in crates/core/
- Documents are a direct extraction/adaptation from the old crate specification
- No developer review or validation has occurred
- Implementation details may need adjustment based on new architectural decisions

**Task Workflow:**
1. AI provides a briefing summarizing the PRD key points and any concerns identified
2. Developer reviews the documents and provides feedback
3. Collaborative iteration to refine requirements, architecture, and implementation approach
4. Update documents based on agreed changes
5. Final validation before implementation begins

**Expected Outcomes:**
- Validated and refined PRD.md aligned with project goals
- Updated PLAN.md with agreed implementation approach
- Clear understanding of scope, priorities, and technical decisions
- Ready-to-implement specification

**Reference Files:**
- crates/core/PRD.md
- crates/core/PLAN.md

title: Define products requirement specification for workspace-core crate.
description: The crate workspace-core is one of the fundamentals base crate. It will perform the initial work of detecting package managers, the type of project (monorepo or single repo). For this task we will initial analyse the old crate that is on temp/wnt-stable/crates/standard and retrieve all the features and spectifications from there. After this we will iterate and produce a final document PRD.md and also the PLAN.md for the implementation.
close_reason: Created PRD.md and PLAN.md documents for workspace-core crate. PRD defines functional and non-functional requirements for package manager detection, project type detection, and monorepo analysis. PLAN provides detailed implementation tasks organized in 6 epics with code examples, acceptance criteria, and ~41.5h estimated effort.

title: Review and update GitHub Actions and release-plz configuration
description:
Review existing GitHub Actions workflows and release-plz configuration for the new workspace structure.

**Context:**
- The CLI will no longer be in Rust (different approach TBD)
- Existing actions (setup-git, setup-node, setup-rust) should be reused
- release-plz.toml needs adjustment for new crate structure
- Workflows need review for the new crates (workspace-fs, workspace-core, etc.)

**Current State:**
- Workflows: pull-request.yml, pull-request-node.yml, release.yml, release-crates.yml, release-node.yml
- Actions: setup-git, setup-node, setup-rust
- Config: temp/wnt-stable/release-plz.toml (old config for reference)

**Tasks:**
1. Review existing workflows and identify what needs updating
2. Update release-plz.toml for new crate structure (workspace-fs, workspace-core)
3. Remove CLI-related release workflows (no Rust CLI anymore)
4. Ensure PR workflows work with new crate structure
5. Update CHANGELOG paths for new crates

**Expected Outcomes:**
- Updated release-plz.toml at project root
- Updated/cleaned workflows for new structure
- Reused existing actions where applicable
